title: Baldur's Gate 3 Costs You 82¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Baldur's Gate 3 is $59.99 on Steam and takes about 73 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): 82 cents an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 181 hours) and it drops to 33 cents an hour. Our own math.
Which game gave you the most hours for your money?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: A movie costs you $6 an hour. Baldur's Gate 3 costs 82 cents. Go 100% and it's 33 cents.
